two successive centrifugations; mild centrifugation followed by stronger centrifugation, resulted in the lowest concentration of serotonin in platelets poor plasma (PPP).

two successive centrifugations, first a mild centrifuge and next a stronger one, is superior to other methods to produce platelet-poor-plasma for serotonin analysis.

the concentration of serotonin in plasma depends on the method of preparation of PPP, and that two consecutive centrifuges are superior to the use single centrifugation and heat shock treatment.
